$comment: ticket-handover-history (REQ-THH-001): a handover carries a note for the colleague. Written together with the new assignee by TicketAssignController::passOn in one save, so OpenRegister's audit trail holds both in the same entry and the History tab's assignee rule shows the note under 'Passed to <assignee> by <actor>'. Hidden from the data widget and the Edit form: it is the note of the latest handover only, and reads as part of the history, not as a field of the ticket. ticket 1.9.0 -> 1.10.0.

handoverNote.title: Handover note
handoverNote.description: What the colleague a ticket was passed to should know, written with the handover. Shown under the handover in the History tab; empty when the latest handover had no note.
